context: A police officer briefs on a corporate fraud risk
purpose: Teach: 功績/加わり/根幹/取り入れる/利回り/多岐/補充/一大

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 御社、過去の功績は申し分ない。
lines.en: Your firm's past achievements are impeccable.
lines.style: Measured, official opening. Even pacing. Slight pause before the compliment—a professional nod, not warmth. Clear diction. Authoritative but not unkind.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規プロジェクトに、警察と監査人も加わりました。
lines.en: Yes. We've also brought in police and auditors for the new project.
lines.style: Respectful and cooperative. Slight lean forward in the delivery. Steady pace, no defensiveness. The tone of someone working alongside, not beneath.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 根幹システム、外部評価を取り入れることをお勧めします。
lines.en: I'd recommend integrating external evaluation into your core systems.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Light emphasis on 「recommend」—advisory, not punitive. Slow, deliberate pace. The voice of someone laying down careful ground rules.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。利回り偽装の事例、多岐にわたって警察庁から共有頂きました。
lines.en: Yes. The NPA has shared yield-falsification cases with us across multiple instances.
lines.style: Factual and alert. Precise articulation. Slight uptick in energy—showing readiness and awareness. No apologetic softening, just competent detail.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 人員補充、一大改革のタイミングですね。
lines.en: Staff replacement during a major reform—this is the right window for it.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. A small nod in the voice. Even tone, but the words carry weight—this is observation, not pressure. Professional closure with underlying respect.
